balls.text: full and it's cracked down to long-ff for a single, Ishant wants the second but is sent back, rightly so
full toss and he tries to go downtown with that one but it ends up being a miscue, straight into the hands of long-off where Ferguson takes an easy one
powerfully struck this time, in the slot on the off stump and he drills it past the bowler and long-off for a much-needed four
two more, sliced away over point, almost identical to the first ball, except that third man runs across this time to cut it off
full on middle, tries to loft him over his head, gets a thick outside edge wide of third man for a couple more
full toss outside off, Steyn makes room and slices it over point, Wagh hauls it in running across from deep point, just the couple in the end
Steyn prevents it, good length on the off stump and he tries to push it through the line, gets a thick inside edge for a single

Marsh is having a ball, length ball and Mishra goes after it first ball, doesn't time it well as he tries to clear mid-off, fails to do so as Bhuvneshwar runs to his left and takes a well-judged catch inside the circle
Sohal goes first ball, bowled short and a fraction wide, Sohal made room to upper-cut it, got an edge but not high enough, Uthappa timed his jump perfectly and grabbed it with one hand
dropped, but would be unfair to call it that, driven hard and low back towards the bowler, Marsh reacted well and dived to his left but couldn't hold on
full outside off and he goes hard at it, looking to drive it through the covers, gets a thick outside edge and gets it past third man, streaky but he'll take it
length ball and Duminy gets under it but can only hit it so far, didn't middle it well and found Rahul Sharma waiting for it at long-off, he ran a few yards to his left, tumbled and clasped it well
picked that low full tos, chipping it over midwicket, just a single again
low full toss on the off, pushed down the ground to long-off
there is a fine leg in place and even though thats a full ball on the legs, a single is all he can manage
aiming for the blockhole, dug out wide of cover for a single
fings the gap, fullish on the off, chips it over extra cover for a couple in the deep as Wagh runs across and cuts it off just inside the ropes
full toss on middle, dragged towards Ganguly at midwicket, makes sure he has it well covered this time, even tumbles
shortish on leg stump, turned past square leg for a single
shoritsh on the off, punched slightly uppishly to long-on for a single
fires it quick on middle, gets back and turns it wide of midwicket for a single
gets across and drives it past midwicket for a single
takes it from middle to turn it past short fine for a single
short of a good length outside off, makes room to cut that past point, misses
full on middle, driven firmly down the ground but to long-off for just the single
slower one bowled slightly short outside off, runs it down to third man for a single
firmly struck, short of a good length and it's punched hard but Ganguly, yes it's him, misfields at extra cover to allow that through to the boundary, not a great start for the man
fullish on the off, driven straight to extra cover
back of a length on middle, rocks back and drops it back down the pitch
the slower offcutter on leg stump, turns it towards square leg for a single
pushed to point for a single
flighted on the off, driven to long-off for a single to get off the mark
floated it on the off stump, dropped into the leg side, thinks of a single but it isn't there
straight one on middle and Christian tries to work that one across the line, it was heading straight and he missed, was caught on the pad, an Asad Rauf had no doubts
quicker delivery on leg from round the wicket, tries to smash it over midwicket, misses, struck on the pads
Christian shapes up to play a sweep past square leg but can't connect
full toss on middle and off, punched down to long-off for a single
short of a good length on the off, third man is up, just the single to Callum Ferguson
slower one bowled short on middle, pulled down to deep square leg for a single
beautifully clipped off his legs, juicy delivery on middle and leg and he flicks it elegantly over square leg for a one bounce four, fine leg is up and that was a poor delivery
Disdainful welcome as Duminy smotes him past long-on for a one-bounce four, short and it's slapped back with venom
short ball outside leg stump, turned it wide of short fine leg for a single
good length on the off, bowled it flat, cracked it to long-off for a single
flighted on middle and off, comes down the track and drives it to long-off for a single
drops it in front of point for a quick single
short of a good length outside off, tries to chop it past point, it turns away to just beat the outside edge
tossed it up on middle, turned away in the direction of wide long-on for a single
shortish, cracked past point for a single
tossed up on middle, driven back to the bowler who collides with Christian and the batsman trips and falls in the process..Yuvraj helps him up and both break into spontaneous laughter
short on middle, worked away past square leg for a single, thinks of a second but is sent back in time even though the throw from the deep from Marsh is a wild one
comes down the track and tickles it wide of midwicket for a single
flighted on the off, driven down the ground to long-on for a single
turned it past square leg for an easy single
Rahul Sharma's ecstatic, he fired that in quicker anf latter on middle, Sangakkara got across and tried to sweep it hard across the line, missed and was caught in front of middle and leg. Gonner
shortish on leg stump, works it behind square leg for a single
short ball on middle, makes room and slaps it towards deep cover for a  single
fullish on middle, turns it wide of midwicket for one more
worked away wide of midwicket for a single
fullish on the off, steered in the direction of point
full on middle, punched it down the ground for a single to keep strike
dug out wide of cover, bowled it full
low full toss and Sangakkara doesn't waste it, comes forward and thwacks it over midwicket for a one bounce four
full on the off, dug out towards extra cover
full, pushed to long-off for a single
played down the ground to long-off by Duminy for a single
short on the off, cracked off the back foot towards deep cover where Parnell misfields and allows them to come back for the second.
flat and quicker through the air on the off, punched down the ground to long-on
drops it wide of point for a single
straightish from round the wicket, turned past square leg for a single
bowled it short outside off, cut towards deep cover for a single
floated it on middle and off, driven back to the bowler
fullish on the pads, clipped towards deep square leg for a single to keep strike
slower one bowled full outside off, squeezed it past point for a single
lovely drive but excellent fielding by Yuvraj at mid-off, driven through the line past mid-off and Yuvraj dives to his right to keep them to a single
Dragged it on, Pune have fought back well, good length and he tries to play an ugly corss-batted heave over midwicket, gets an inside edge and the off stump is out of the ground
on middle and leg, tickles it towards fine leg for a single
short of a good length outside off, guided behind point for a single
short of a good length on middle, kept low, whipped it through midwicket for a single to keep strike
round the wicket, just nudged towards square leg, the fielder is deep enough so they come back for the second with ease
Yuvraj gets the breakthrough, Dhawan came down the track to smack that in the direction of long-on but miscued it completely, Jesse Ryder at extra cover got under that one and took it comfortably
flatter on middle, Dhawan reverse-sweeps that hard to point, straight to the fielder though
drops it on the off side wide of point for a single
slightly short on middle and leg, tries to whip it square, struck high on the pads
what a reply from Dhawan, short delivery but it still had to be dispatched, short on the off and he swung it away over the square-leg boundary for another flat six, also raises the 50 stand

lovely yorker form Parnell, angled in towards middle and leg and he managed to just about dig it out into the leg side, getting his leg out of the way, Parnell deliberately collided into Dhawan after that, all in good humour of course
banged it short on middle, gets back and drops it down in front of cover
good length again and he decides to play that off the back foot, tries to get back and run that down to third man, misses
Teja's struck that well, good length and he drove that up on the up, got forward and placed it between mid-off and extra cover
full on middle, almost yorker length, dug out towards cover
Flat one, was bowled on a length and Dhawan had made his mind up, charged down the track and took it from the slot to deposit it over the bowler's head
floated it on middle, turned away past square leg into the deep for one more
short of a good length on middle and off, gets back and turns it wide of midwicket for a single
fired it on middle and off, Dhawan sweeps it straight to Mitchell Marsh at square leg
quicker through the air, flat outside off, guided wide of point for a single
short on middle, gets on the back foot and works it past midwicket for a single
good bounce, short on the off, Dhawan waits for it to come on and opens the face to run it down to third man for a single
short and wide and Dhawan senses a chance, waits for it and cuts it hard past the diving point for a boundary
punched off the back foot in the direction of mid-off for a single
banged it short on middle, ducked under it easily, called a wide for height

dropped, put down at square leg, short of a good length and Dhawan whips it from the crease, a dive to the right at square leg but the fielder fails to latch on, it was catchable, many would have taken it, Wagh was the man there, it went to his wrong side
lands on a good length outside off, steered down to third man for a single
slightly short on the off, gets front and across and taps it in front of mid-on for a quick single
short of a good length on the off, punched back to the bowler from the crease
short of a good length on the off, run down to third man for a single
drops it short on the off side, gets back and knocks it down in front of point for a single
poor delivery, width again for Ravi Teja and he chops it hard past the diving Jesse Ryder for four more
slightly short on the off, Dhawan tries to jab it past midwicket but mistimes it towards mid-on, just the single in the end as it falls safely
width again and he caresses it through the off side, lands on a good length and he leans into the shot, driving it between cover and cover point for four more
fiercely cut away this time, short and he seized on the length early and slashed it over the point fielder
short and wide, there to cut and he chases it, misses
back of a length, dropping it short outside off, tries to upper cut but decides against it after it's too late, it's already gone past him
short of a good length this time, gets on the back foot and punches it to point
lands it full on middle and off, stays in the crease and defends it cautiously back to the bowler
back of a length, around off, pushed wide of cover for one
another late-cut to third man, not much room available
width provided, cut away to a square third man
cut away, and a misfield at point allows a single
plays and misses as he looks to cut one
back of a length, around off, looks to guide it fine, can't beat point
slightly short, another googly, clipped away through square leg to seal a second successive win after a horror run of seven straight losses
the googly, gets forward to defend on the off side, gets a thick inside edge to short fine leg
full on middle, makes room and steers that through to deep point for a single
short on middle, tucked through square leg for a single
plays and misses, short of a length outside off, tried to run it down to third man, misses
short and it's a short-arm pull from Ganguly, gets it on the bounce to mid-on
good length outside off, plays it wide of point, a diving point, for a single
backs away a hint, good length just outside off, drops it in front of point and steals a quick single
three in a row, hastening Pune's win here, low full toss on middle, gets across and drives it elegantly through midwicket for a boundary, sweet timing
superbly done, pitched up again and gets the treatment, in the slot outside off, makes room and cracks it over extra cover for four more
lovely shot, Christian pitched it full on middle, Ferguson made a bit of room and drove it handsomely over the bowler's head for a boundary
shortish on the off, tries to punch it straight, gets a thick  inside edge towards square leg
short ball down the leg side, Ferguson walks across to pull it fine, misses

bowled'im! Short of a good length and Yuvraj chases that one as well, goes for the pull again, gets an inside edge to lose his middle stump., The umpire wants to confirm if that's a no-ball and replays show it wasn't, he has to go
the slower bouncer, landing on middle and then nipping away, Yuvraj had thought of the pull but wisely backed out at the end
short, cut over point, not fiercely, just gently, two more wide of third man and it's time for the ad break
slower one, picked it up at the last moment, made room and then adjusted, dabbing it into the off side
bangs it short on middle and leg, gets back and tries to fend it away, is struck on the ribs
Steyn misfields, lets it right through, full outside off, squeezed down to third man where Steyn makes a mess, a poor day for ground fielding, generally
Ganguly goes after that one, was bowled on a length outside off, walked across and tried to swing it over midwicket, missed, was in the slot and the shot was on
shortish on the off, gets back and turns it through square leg for a single
short on the off, turns it away through square leg for a single
banged it short on leg, worked it down to fine leg for a single, has a word with Steyn, all friendly stuff
back of a length on the off, drops it in front of point, no single on offer there
streaky, full on middle, makes room to caress that through the covers, gets an inside edge, just wide of the leg stump, to the fine-leg boundary
good length on the off, pushes it back to the bowler
good length outside off, Ganguly shapes up to play the cut but opts against it in the end, leaving it alone
slightly short on middle, turned away through square leg for a single
it's a quicker delivery, a low full toss on middle, played straight to midwicket, no damage done
round the wicket, called a no-ball, freehit coming up, it's pushed back to the bowler
bowled it short outside leg stump, tickled wide of fine leg and Chipli fumbles in the deep to allow them to come back for the second
six to Ganguly, comes down the track and and picks that googly well, charges down and swings it high and handsome over deep square leg for a big one
worked away off the front foot to midwicket
gets forward and pushes it down the pitch
good comeback, good length on the off, pushed to cover
short and wide and Yuvraj slashes hard but misses, Sanga takes a chance with Saheba, appealing vociferously but that wasn't given, no contact

gone, banged in short on the off and it nipped back in, Uthappa tried to evade it and it went off the shoulder to the keeper, the umpire Saheba gives it out thinking it went off the bat, a poor decision and Uthappa is so shocked he walks away with a smile
quick single by Ganguly, short of a good length, drops it in front of extra cover and steals a single
shortish on the off, gets across and turns it wide of midwicket for a single
short of a good lenght outside off, runs it down to third man for a single
didn't pick the googly, turns in and Uthappa left it alone thinking it would go away

trapped in front for 49, was the legspinner, bowled flat on leg stump and turned towards middle just a hint, Pandey got across and tried to turn the face, missed it and was caught right in front, Asad Rauf had no hesitation
connects well with the slog-sweep, was flighted and landed in the slot on middle, gets forward, bends low and swings it into the stands
short of a good length on the off, driven on the up to extra cover
tossed up on middle, gets across and turns it to midwicket
slightly short on middle, turns away a hint, pushed back to the bowler
nicely defended, short on middle gets behind it well and knocks it back down the pitch
fires it on a good length on middle, nicely tickled away to deep square leg for a single
good length outside off, keeps a little low, Pandey fails to get his bat under that one, he then has a go at the batsman, a few words said
short of a good lenght on middle, plays it back to the bowler
short and wide, cuts hard, gets a thick edge wide of the diving Sangakkara and to the third-man boundary, streaky stuff
Short ball on the off, gets on the back foot and plays it to cover
shortish outside off, cut down towards third man for a single to keep strike
back of a length outside off, run down behind point, wide of third man, for a single
goes for the pull this time, doesn't get hold of that one, bounced more than he would have liked and got it high on the bat as he tried to go over midwicket, landed safely, a couple in the end
Ganguly's on his way, trademark stuff, short of a good length, he makes room and slaps that over the in-field over extra cover for a boundary
short of a good length, crunched off the back foot towards Duminy at point
good length on middle, driven through the line down the ground for a single to long-on
slow and short on the off, rocks back and pushes it to long-on for a single
punched off the back foot between long-on and deep midwicket for a couple of runs
pushed to point from the crease
short ball on the off, comes down the track and punches it to long-off to get off the mark this season, huge cheers, everyone in the Pune camp is on their feet
floating it on the off stump, no turn there, dabs it into the off side, thinks of a single but isn't there
short on leg stump to Ganguly, he turns it away to short fine leg, decides against the single
he's doling out freebies here is JP, short on the off and it's pulled away, yet again, in that gap between deep midwicket and deep square leg for a one bounce four
pushes it fuller with a bit more pace, Pandey rocks back and defends it into the off side
Pandey's smashing it, another short ball, poor stuff from Duminy, he gets into position early and dismisses it over square leg
short of a good length on the off, played away to extra cover
played for the turn, opening the face but it goes on straight to beat the outside edge
Duminy drags it really short this time, another long ho[p, easy pickings for Pandey as he rocks back to pull it over midwicket
cautiously played into the off side, tossed up on the off, gets forward and pushes it in the direction of extra cover
bowled'im! Swings across the line does Jesse, slower through the air and he wants to dispatch it over square leg, misses as it turns in and the off stump is pegged back
short ball on the off, cracked off the back foot through the infield for a single
flighted on middle and off, defended into the off side
short on middle, punched down the ground for a single to long-on
short of a good length on middle, turns it through square leg for a single
a googly that Ryder failed to pick, had opted top play it into the leg side, turned away as he stabbed at it, took the edge and beat short third man to the ropes
gets on the back foot and turns it into the leg side for a single
chips it back towards the bowler but lands short of him
the googly, turns in and he didn't pick that, tried to open the face, struck on the pads but outside the line
short, long hop, Pandey waits for it to turn away and pulls him hard over midwicket for a boundary
flat on middle and leg, pushed back to the bowler
short and he made room to smote that over extra cover, got an inside edge in the end, just past leg stump
round the wicket to Jesse, goodish length on leg stump, pushed down to midwicket
back of a length outside off, drops it down to third man for a single
short of a good length on middle, punched down into the leg side
banged it short on the off, gets out of the way to leave it through
good length and Pandey manages to squeeze that through, opening the face at just the right time to beat third man to the ropes
slightly short, gets back and knocks it straight to extra cover
on the stumps this time, punched off the back foot to extra cover
lands over the shamiana behind long-on, flat delivery but Ryder came down the track and tonked it over the ropes for another big one
short of a good length, quicker through the air, on leg stump, tries to turn it away, is struck on the pads
short ball, fetches it from the off and pulls it towards ;long-on for a single
shortish on middle, dragged towards deep square leg for a single
gets a leading edge as he plays across the line to one that spun away, closed the face a little too early there but was fortunate, again, that it landed safely
slightly short on middle, turned away past square leg for a single
slightly short on the off stump, knocks it down into the leg side in front of the bowler for a well-taken single
went straight on, short of a good length, Pandey made room it open the face, missed
misfield, short and it's punched hard into the off side, straight towards Dhawan at extra cover and he lets it through his legs, four more
beaten, turns away a hint after landing outside off, Pandey pushes at it but is beaten by the turn
another one, bowled on a length again and he picks it up over mid-on for another boundary, Pune are motoring along here
length ball and Ryder treats it with utter disdain, smacks it back over the bowler's head for a one bounce four
bowls it on a good length on the off, square-driven towards point but can't beat the field
had made his mind up to play a cross-batted shot but changed his mind at the last moment and ended up chipping it over the in-field, was fortunate to get away with it
short of a good length on the off again, dropped in front of point
short of a good length on the off, knocked away into the off side
An excellent start for Pune, slower ball this time from Steyn, slower ball bowled full on the off and it's smashed past extra cover for four more
a bouncer gone bad down the leg side, called a wide
That's smashed into the second tier, short and he latches onto it quickly, rocks back and sends it miles into the crowd behind square leg
short of a good length outside off, Ryder just punches it between cover and point, all timing there, lovey shot for four
short of a good length, gets forward and pushes it down towards mid-on
nips back in from a good length on the off, gets back and drops it in front of cover
short of a good length on the off, drops it into the off side from the crease
